old_caption: The video captures a scene where a pile of papers is engulfed in flames on a patch of ground. The fire starts small but quickly intensifies, with bright orange and yellow flames licking at the edges of the burning papers. As the fire grows, it consumes more of the paper, leaving behind a charred and blackened area. The ground around the fire appears to be dry soil or dirt, which is also beginning to be scorched. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the fire and the immediate surroundings. There are no visible animals or people in the frame, and the background remains consistent, showing only the ground and the fire. The intensity of the flames fluctuates slightly, indicating the varying rates at which the papers burn.

caption: The video captures a small crumpled pile of white paper burning on an outdoor ground surface of dark, charred ash and dirt. Orange and yellow flames rise and lick continuously across the top of the pile, their tips flickering, growing taller and shorter and shifting shape from frame to frame, showing ongoing combustion rather than a single flash. The burning pile itself remains in roughly the same location, so the visible motion is flame deformation, not the object's movement. A pale dry leaf lies undisturbed at the lower left and a faint ring of burnt residue surrounds the pile, confirming the ground stays static. The lower white flap persists throughout while its edges blacken, with no large structural change visible within this excerpt. The handheld framing gradually widens to reveal more bare dirt at left and ashy ground at right.
